title: HelperSSHLeaseResult
description: What acquiring a lease answered: the reference, and the fingerprint of the host key observed at dial time. The fingerprint is not decoration — the helper-install path keys consent by the machine's host key (ADR-0023) and used to read the value off its own lease, so keeping it here is what makes the coordinator's answer to 'which machine did I just ask' unchanged by the dial having moved one process out.

lease.description: The reference the helper holds. It is opaque: the coordinator echoes it verbatim on every probe and on the release.

hostKeyFingerprint.description: The SHA256 fingerprint of the TARGET host's public key as presented and verified at dial time. Empty is not a valid answer for a lease that was acquired: a connection whose key was never established could not have been authenticated.
